itens.titulo: Lumentum (LITE) Earnings Expected to Grow: Should You Buy?
itens.descricao: Lumentum (LITE) Earnings Expected to Grow: Should You Buy? Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Lumentum (LITE) is expected to deliver a year-over-year increase in earnings on higher revenues when it reports results for the quarter ended September 2026.
The earnings report, which is expected to be released on November 5, might help the stock move higher if these key numbers are better than expectations.
Zacks Consensus Estimate This optical networking products maker is expected to post quarterly earnings of $4.22 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +283.6%.
Revenues are expected to be $1.25 billion, up 134.2% from the year-ago quarter.
Estimate Revisions Trend The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has been revised 0.03% higher over the last 30 days to the current level.

itens.titulo: Marvell’s Lumentum Bid Is a Bet That Light, Not Copper, Wins the AI Data Center
itens.descricao: Marvell’s Lumentum Bid Is a Bet That Light, Not Copper, Wins the AI Data Center Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - MRVL dropped 11% while LITE jumped 5% premarket, as Lumentum's ~$83B valuation far outstrips Marvell's $3.92B cash on hand.
- Murphy said copper's bandwidth limits are driving customers to optical interconnects, but the shift will "take several years, with both technologies coexisting." - Just released.
Late on October 28, 2026, Bloomberg reported that Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) is near a deal to buy Lumentum Holdings (NASDAQ:LITE) in an AI push.
In premarket trading on October 29, Marvell fell about 11% to $222.81.
What Has Been Reported and What Hasn't Reuters cited a source who said the companies are in advanced talks, with a deal that could be announced as soon as next week after its October 28 report.
No press release, no 8-K (the form companies file with the SEC to disclose major events) and no board statement exists.

itens.titulo: Marvell nears deal for optical supplier Lumentum to bolster hardware, report says
itens.descricao: Marvell nears deal for optical supplier Lumentum to bolster hardware, report says Yahoo Finance
trechos: Investing.com -- Shares of Lumentum Holdings Inc (NASDAQ:LITE) surged more than 6% in premarket trading Thursday after Bloomberg reported that chipmaker Marvell Technology Inc (NASDAQ:MRVL) is in advanced discussions to acquire the optical equipment supplier.
Meanwhile, Marvell stock tumbled over 12%, weighed down by the prospect of digesting a megadeal alongside broader sector pressure stemming from Alphabet Inc.'s steep cash-flow burn.

An outright purchase of Lumentum, valued at approximately $83 billion against Marvell's $221 billion market capitalization, would rank among the ten largest tech and telecom mergers in history, according to Bloomberg data.
